chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Studio pianos: Steinway, Baldwin and Art Tatum's tuning
summary: Steinway serviced the studios, pianos were kept at 440, and a tuner came every other day for Art Tatum.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: What about the piano?
The quality of the piano at these different studios?
The piano? Well most of the pianos -- they always had good pianos, because Steinway always serviced those studios.
Everything was Steinway back in those days. Wasn't no Kanabe(inaudible) other piano getting in there, you know.
Steinway was in all the studios --
Baldwins?
